proposals.before: The Queen Mother looks down—who shall serve as secondary offering?
proposals.after: Sovereign Earth looks down in regard—who shall serve as secondary offering?
proposals.reason: 后皇 denotes Sovereign Earth (Houhuang), not the Queen Mother; the parallel line names 文祖 as the secondary offering partner.

proposals.before: The Queen Mother looks down in regard—who shall be secondary offering?
proposals.after: Sovereign Earth looks down in regard—who shall be secondary offering?
proposals.reason: Literal English likewise renders 后皇 as Queen Mother; Sovereign Earth matches the ritual diction.

proposals.before: As the emperor's father, honored with a vast name—for ten thousand years fortune and peace; in annals one need not speak as of King Ling's passing.
proposals.after: As the emperor's father, honored with a vast name—for ten thousand years fortune and peace; in annals one need not speak as of Chu's Mingling.
proposals.reason: 楚冥靈 is the legendary long-lived Mingling of Chu in Zhuangzi, not King Ling of Chu; the idiomatic rendering invents the wrong referent.

proposals.before: As the Son of Heaven's father, registers a vast name—ten thousand years, a thousand years of fortune, peace, and ease; in spring and autumn one does not speak of King Ling of Chu's death.
proposals.after: As the Son of Heaven's father, registers a vast name—ten thousand years, a thousand years of fortune, peace, and ease; in spring and autumn one does not speak of Chu's Mingling.
proposals.reason: Literal likewise turns 楚冥靈 into King Ling of Chu's death; it is the Zhuangzi Mingling tree/creature, not a king.

proposals.before: Daily in the broad hall discussing Tang and Yu; seeking good governance, thinking of Du and Yu; ruler and ministers one in virtue, aspirations mutually trusting.
proposals.after: Daily in the broad hall discussing Tang and Yu; seeking good governance, thinking of the 'du-yu' assent; ruler and ministers one in virtue, aspirations mutually trusting.
proposals.reason: 都俞 is the classical assent formula, not two persons named Du and Yu.

decisions.reason: In this state-sacrifice hymn, 后皇 denotes Sovereign Earth. The Queen Mother is a different figure and does not fit the accompanying-offering question.
The literal field must likewise render 后皇 as Sovereign Earth rather than the Queen Mother.

decisions.after: As the emperor's father, honored with a magnificent title—for ten thousand years, may he enjoy fortune, health, and peace; let none speak of Chu's long-lived Mingling tree.
decisions.reason: 楚冥靈 invokes the fabulously long-lived Mingling tree of Chu, not King Ling's death. Naming the tree and its longevity makes the allusion intelligible in English.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 萬年千歲福康寧，春秋不說楚冥靈

decisions.after: As the Son of Heaven's father, he is registered under a magnificent name—for ten thousand years, a thousand years of fortune, peace, and ease; speak no more of Chu's long-lived Mingling tree.
decisions.reason: The literal field also invents King Ling's death. 冥靈 is the long-lived Mingling tree from the classical longevity allusion.
都俞 is the classical formula of ready assent between ruler and ministers, not two people named Du and Yu. The proposed literal wording preserves the formula without inventing names.
